The dried, nearly ripe fruit of Elet- taria cardamomum var. minuscula. Only the seeds are used in making preparations of cardamom and they are used immediate- ly after removal from the fruit. The seeds should not be stored af- ter removal from the fruit. They have a strongly aromatic odour and taste and contain not less than 4% v/w of volatile oil. USNF 26 (Cardamom Seed). The dried ripe seed of Elettaria cardamomum (Zingiberaceae), recently removed from the cap- sule. Preserve against attack by insects. Profile Preparations of cardamom are used as carminatives and as fla- vours. The seeds have culinary uses. Cardamom seeds are the source of cardamom oil (below).
